GS.rationale: Goldman Sachs presents a strong fundamental profile with accelerating earnings (+24.3% YoY EPS growth, +14.4% revenue growth in Q1 2026), expanding margins (operating margin 37.5%, net margin ~30%), and improving ROE (14.7% from 12.0%). The strategic pivot back to core institutional strengths and growing fee-based AWM revenue ($115B alternatives fundraising record) strengthens the franchise narrative. However, the stock has already re-rated significantly — P/E of 18.0x is near the top of its 365-day range (14.5x–18.9x), P/B of 2.65x is similarly stretched, and the equity-risk premium over the 10-year Treasury is a thin ~106bps. Leverage has increased (assets/equity from 14.2x to 16.8x) while equity was flat. The Q2 earnings release on July 14 (consensus EPS $14.01, +28.4% YoY) provides a near-term catalyst, and the SpaceX/OpenAI/Anthropic IPO pipeline offers deal visibility, but the stock is priced for this execution. Net: good fundamentals and trajectory, but valuation is full-to-slightly-expensive vs own history, leaving a mildly positive but not compelling risk/reward.
